about_the_game:
Knol has spent his whole life in the small village of Silk. Wanting to see the world and find a new future, he joins the Adventurers’ Guild in the city of Nils. But just as his new life begins, danger reaches the place he calls home.

Road of Heart is a classic retro fantasy JRPG about leaving your quiet beginnings behind, growing stronger through battle, and protecting what matters most. Explore multiple regions, master class-based combat, learn additional abilities through scrolls, and combine skills in turn-based battles against slimes, monsters, and greater threats ahead.

Features:

  • Explore a pixel-art fantasy world of villages, roads, guilds, and dangerous lands

  • Choose a class and shape your combat style with weapons and scroll-based abilities

  • Fight in classic turn-based JRPG battles and combine skills for stronger attacks

  • Travel through multiple regions, meet adventurers and townsfolk, and uncover guild and kingdom mysteries

  • Enjoy a nostalgic retro presentation inspired by 16-bit adventures
